# pandharpurdarshan.com

Pandharpur Darshan is the official guide and booking platform for Pandharpur pilgrimage (Pandharpur Wari / Vari). It provides information about Vitthal Rukmini Mandir darshan, Ashadhi Ekadashi, Kartiki Ekadashi, temple timings, hotel and bhaktaniwas bookings, travel information, and local business listings for pilgrims visiting Pandharpur, Maharashtra, India.

## Key information sources

- Homepage: https://pandharpurdarshan.com
- Temple guide with darshan timings: https://pandharpurdarshan.com/temples
- Complete darshan and yatra guide: https://pandharpurdarshan.com/pandharpur-darshan-yatra-guide
- Festival calendar (Ashadhi Ekadashi, Kartiki Ekadashi): https://pandharpurdarshan.com/pandharpur-festivals
- Accommodation and bookings: https://pandharpurdarshan.com/pandharpur-bookings
- Attractions: https://pandharpurdarshan.com/pandharpur-attractions

## About Pandharpur

Pandharpur is a pilgrimage town in Solapur District, Maharashtra, India. It is home to the Vitthal Rukmini Mandir — one of the most significant Hindu pilgrimage sites in Maharashtra. The Pandharpur Wari (yatra) is a 700+ year old tradition attracting millions of Warkari pilgrims during Ashadhi Ekadashi (June/July) and Kartiki Ekadashi (October/November).
